message: マーク

name: Lolotte
message: 「Uuu... What should I do?」

name: Azel
message: 「Go home」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Don't say that, please tell me. Aren't we close?」

name: Azel
message: 「Our relationship is nothing special」
When I came to the library to borrow some books, I ran into Azel and Lolotte.
They seemed to be having some kind of argument in front of the entrance. Lolotte was clutching Azel's cuff and refusing to let go.

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, what are you two doing?」

name: Azel
message: 「I am alone. I merely came to the reading room to look at a photo book」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Sob, sob, I'm here too」

name: Azel
message: 「She is simply clinging to me on her own. Let go」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I didn't actually want to separate either, you know」

name: Lolotte
message: 「What should I do to make up with a friend I had a fight with?」

name: Azel
message: 「I do not know. Take this person named Amyrina and go home at once」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I'm saying I don't know how to take her with me~」

name: Synn
message: 「Take her where?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Eek!? I-I-I-It's nothing at all」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yeah, right, it's no big deal. So calm down, Lolotte」

name: Azel
message: 「Put your wings away」

name: Synn
message: 「Azel...! Shh, shhhhhh!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I-I-I-I'm not an angel or anything!」

name: Synn
message: 「T-That's right! No matter how you look at her, she's human!!」

name: Azel
message: 「That is incorrect」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hauah!?」

name: Synn
message: 「A-Azel, come on...!」
Probably to avert her eyes from Lolotte and me, Azel looks up at the library's second-floor terrace. Even so, she doesn't shake Lolotte off at all. She's being considerate in her own way.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Higuu...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Huh? My tests are full of ×'s」

name: Azel
message: 「Mine too」

name: Lolotte
message: 「We're two of a kind, sparkle sparkle~♪」

name: Synn
message: 「No, I don't think that's quite...」

name: Azel
message: 「It's \s07」
Azel keeps her gaze fixed on the second floor of the library--on its outer wall.

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, I see! You found a mark too, Azel」

name: Azel
message: 「I did. What is that?」

name: Synn
message: 「The library and the school building are old structures, right? They've been renovated many times, but they try to preserve the original materials as much as possible」

name: Synn
message: 「That mark is the stamp of the manufacturer that made the firebricks」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Kuwawah! I can't see it at all? All the bricks around there are rough and completely flat」

name: Synn
message: 「They aren't on every single one」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm, probably so they don't form a pattern. They're mixed in at a modest rate of about one in every few hundred」

name: Azel
message: 「I see. Understood」

name: Azel
message: 「There's one in that corner over there too, a ◎」

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa! Amazing, I never managed to spot that one」

name: Azel
message: 「Why are there multiple marks?」

name: Synn
message: 「Bricks from all sorts of manufacturers were used, so nobody knows how many types there are in total」

name: Synn
message: 「Back when I first enrolled, I used to run around looking for them with my friends as a game」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Friends...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I-I'll find one too!」

name: Synn
message: 「H-Huh? You let go of my sleeve」

name: Azel
message: 「...Hehe」

name: Lolotte
message: 「President, I found it under the window over there! It's a mark with the character '疎'!」

name: Synn
message: 「M-My feathers...」

name: Synn
message: 「Ahem! There are actually quite a few of those bricks. They were probably fired for the neighboring town's canal, and the leftovers got repurposed here」

name: Azel
message: 「It's ◇. Right to the left of the second round window from the right」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hmph, I'll go find something even rarer. *Rumblerrrr*」

name: Azel
message: 「Slightly to the lower right, dead ahead... there's a * mark」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-You've got really good eyes, don't you, Azel?」

name: Azel
message: 「Do I?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「President, President♪」
Ah, more feathers again...

name: Lolotte
message: 「Huge discovery! I found something weird. What does 'skrowleetS iesuyR' mean?」

name: Synn
message: 「You read that backwards. It's 'Ryuusei Steelworks.'」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I see~! Now that you mention it, the Vice President did say that ancient writing is read in reverse.」

name: Azel
message: 「Is that so?」

name: Synn
message: 「Hm...? Wait a second. The only things you ever find are symbol marks, right, Azel?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「President, the characters here are really difficult. It's going to take some time before you're able to read them.」

name: Azel
message: 「I-I know that!」

name: Azel
message: 「There, five!」

name: Azel
message: 「Over there, six!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hawaaah!? He's getting mad and pointing at the few kanji numeral marks he actually knows!」

name: Synn
message: 「L-Lolotte... stop saying things that only pour oil on the fire.」

name: Azel
message: 「...I'm not angry」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Oka~y♪ It's like a treasure hunt, so it's fun」

name: Azel
message: 「Indeed. I understand」

name: Azel
message: 「Hold on, don't run away」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Fueh~?」

name: Azel
message: 「I cannot offer you advice. However, I have zero intention of aiding your escapism」

name: Azel
message: 「If you have time for such pointless antics, go to Amyrina」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I-It's not pointless, you know」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Someday I'm going to come here with Amyrina and play at finding the marks together... Because non-students can use the library on weekends, too」

name: Azel
message: 「I see. Understood」

name: Azel
message: 「Even so, do not let your wings show in public」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hiiin!? I-I-I-I'm not showing the~m!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ahahahaha」

name: Lolotte
message: 「President?」

name: Synn
message: 「Sorry about that」

name: Synn
message: 「Seeing Azel, with that angel's halo of his, lecturing Lolotte just seemed kind of heartwarming」

name: Azel
message: 「A halo? I have no such thing」

name: Synn
message: 「I mean the shine in your hair. You take good care of it, huh? It's so silky and pretty」

name: Azel
message: 「Is 'angel's halo' a metaphor?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, it is?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Heehee, an angel just passed by, didn't it」

name: Azel
message: 「Incorrect. It was running」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hawawawawah!?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Y-You know how sometimes you're chatting, and suddenly everything goes dead silent?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「In this world, they say 'an angel is passing by' when it gets quiet like that. Hmph!」

name: Azel
message: 「A fine expression. I did not know it.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It's my way of paying you back for teaching me things, Azel-san.」

name: Azel
message: 「I have instructed you in nothing.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It's fine. *Smile*」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Well then, I'll be off now♪」

name: Synn
message: 「Lolotte, you should hurry as much as you can.」

name: Synn
message: 「No matter how firmly baked a brick is, the marks will fade away as it's exposed to wind and rain.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I-I'll do my best!」
After Lolotte left, Azel and I searched for marks just a little longer, and then headed inside the building.
...To be pedantic, what Lolotte said about 'an angel passing by' is wrong. That phrase refers to an unexpected silence that falls during casual chatter among a large group.
The silence between Azel and me wasn't like that.
Still, pointing that out would probably be pretty tactless.
